en.plugin.name: Immich

en.plugin.configs.authMode.label: Authentication method

en.plugin.configs.apiKey.label: API Key
en.plugin.configs.email.label: Login email
en.plugin.configs.password.label: Login password
en.plugin.configs.directoryMode.label: Browse mode
